title: LouveSystems' Realms
description:
🌟 The world is yoursRealms is a multiplayer strategy game you can play with up to 8 of your friends!

The Emperor has been assassinated - now the Council must decide who will rule next. 

You are but a minor realm of this land, but if you were to gain more land, more riches - in a word more importance - then that next emperor could be you!

Conquer the lands of Warrica, battle with your neighbors, ramp up your defense and set up a robust economy. Upgrade your realm and don't forget to build a handful of temples, for the Council is quite fond of them.

🏰 Watch your strategy play outRealms is a unique strategy game where all actions are taken simultaneously - then resolved all at once. There's no waiting for your turn here, you play with everybody and speed matters less than a sound strategy and a plan. 

🖱 Play only with your mouse. While up to 8 players are supported in the full version, the game works just aswell with 2 to 4 players and scales accordingly. Got no friends yet? Not a problem - you can play against the CPU just fine! 

🤝Buy once for you and your friends If you host the game while playing on the full version, any joinee coming from the Web version will also enjoy the full game while in your party. That means if you buy the game once and host, everybody can enjoy the full experience of Realms without spending a cent!

I'm a small developer doing this on my free time so all contribution is appreciated nonetheless. I hope this will help you share the game and try it out without holding back. ❤

🌐 Works accross regions and systemsGetting Realms on Steam gives you access to the Windows version for better comfort aswell as fully offline/LAN play. Give it a try!

The game is currently available in English and French, and while fully functional a lot of content updates and improvements are in the works to make the experience as complete as possible. 

💬 Join the community!Join the community on discord if you want to find other players or submit suggestions and bug reports - we'd love to hear from you!
description_short: Realms is a strategy game where all actions are taken simultaneously then resolved all at once. With up to 8 players, there's no waiting for your turn here. Battle for land and for riches, upgrade your kingdom and follow your strategy to conquer other realms - become the one to rule them all.
